  • Method Details

    • observe

      Sentence.Compiled.Connected observe(Consumer<List<Object>> consumer)
      Defines a Consumer to be called each time a set or parameters is processed by the statement.

      Very useful for tracking the progress of long batch operations

      Parameters:
      consumer - the consumer to be called each time the statement is executed. Only a single consumer can be defined at any time. If null, removes any previously defined consumer.
      Returns:
      the current sentence, for chained invocations
